body.statement: There are positive constants depending only on \(d,\alpha,\beta,\gamma,L,e_0\) such that, whenever \(a\le c\ell^\alpha\), \(b\le c\ell^\beta\), and \(ab\le ch^\gamma\), every \(P_{s,\lambda}\), every \(P_{\mathrm{const},\xi}\), and \(Q_{\mathrm{const}}\) belong to \(\mathcal M_H\). Moreover, \(\theta(P_{s,\lambda})=-sab/(1/4-a^2)\), \(\theta(P_{\mathrm{const},\xi})=0\), and \(\theta(Q_{\mathrm{const}})=4ab\).
body.justification: The obstruction and pair test are relevant only when every component and mixture law remains in the unchanged destination class.
body.gap: Kennedy et al. prove localized fuzzy-family membership for a nonprivate lower bound; this statement adds exact shared-sign and constant convex-hull algebra tailored to a private upper test.
body.consumer: It makes both finite obstructions and the pair-test guarantee same-class statements.
